title: Nginx Reverse Proxy
definition: In production, it is highly recommended to run Express behind a reverse proxy like Nginx. Nginx handles SSL termination (HTTPS), serves static files 10x faster than Express, handles load balancing, and forwards standard HTTP requests to Express running on a local port.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Nginx Reverse Proxy?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
